vectors.description: a version compared with itself: the same rules on the same engine, every case unchanged and none listed
the same rule selected with another output; a case without expectations makes the change unexpected, and an unchanged case is only counted
another rule selected with the same output
another rule selected with another output
the same selection and outputs with other unknown rules; unknown rules are a set, compared sorted
a case that now raises an error: only the error is compared, and the side's status is error
errors with the same code and compared fields are the same, whatever the rules' descriptions: other rules, no change
errors of the same code that differ in a compared field (the rule) are a change
a decision without a single output has no output key, and its outputs are compared position by position
a decision that gains a single output under another policy changes its output, though its outputs are the same
a decision table and the rule set it compiles to are the same rules
max_explained changes are explained, each side with a decision: the unexpected changes first, in comparison order, then the expected ones
